verdict.rationale: Supabase documents built-in Advisors, programmatic checks against the live schema that return findings such as missing indexes, which covers index recommendations. It also documents Logs for inspecting events across hosted project services. The evidence never describes a slow-query view or a performance-metrics dashboard, so only part of the story is shown. Missing for 10: documented slow-query insights view, performance metrics (latency, CPU, query stats) in the dashboard, hands-on or independent corroboration.
